note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a SUR 8; A06b SUR 8; L05 SUR 11(2), 11(4)): ordinary naturalisation after 5 years' residence; no renunciation of other citizenships required; a citizen loses the citizenship on voluntarily taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Suriname, 2024
sources.said: Person has been resident in Suriname for 5 years immediately preceding the application. ... n.a. ... Person acquires citizenship of another country by naturalisation or declaration.
